The Memphis Grizzlies are signing No. 32 pick Richie Saunders on a two-way NBA contract, Andy Shiffman and Mark Bartelstein of Priority Sports tell ESPN. Saunders -- rehabbing from a torn ACL in February -- has been cleared to increase his on-court activities and the move allows him to begin practicing with the Grizzlies.
